draft.subject: Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE. Your computer vision models have to run somewhere reliable, and that is the side of the stack I would be working on.

I have shipped vision to hardware before. I deployed a YOLO tracker with TensorRT on a Jetson for a live robotic control loop, and it ran far faster than the same model in eager PyTorch. At a research centre I used monocular depth estimation to profile cracks in metal surfaces. I also compressed a small language model with quantization to fit a tight memory budget, and wrote custom CUDA kernels for convolution. The role is about getting models like these onto new embedded platforms, which matches what I have been doing.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
